periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the snout, sloping downward toward the nose.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a width-to-height ratio of approximately 2:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate downward tapering with the geometric center positioned in the upper half of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curve along the posterior edge of the transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick band occupying approximately 25-30% of the visible dorsal length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Distance between pinnae is roughly 1.5 times the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded convex curvature at the superior boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a translucent, blue-tinted spherical object on the floor surface adjacent to the posterior limb.
